build.environment: QEMU i386, CPU 486, 64 MiB RAM, serial console; disposable FAT16 images and 6-12 s observations unless a longer setup run is recorded

apps.name: Warcraft: Orcs & Humans
apps.summary: Extracted `war.exe` needs a DOS/4GW protected-mode payload; the installer stops on `OUT 43h` (`E6`).

apps.name: Checks & Balances
apps.summary: Configuration and the supplied DEMO work (`TRUE $2450.20`, `BANK $279.04`); ledger entry, save and reopen are unverified.

apps.name: FreeDOS MORE
apps.summary: Help, exact short-file text, redirected stdin and 24-line paging/quit verified.

apps.name: FreeDOS FC
apps.summary: Equal/different text and `/B` binary comparisons produce the correct results.

apps.name: FDBanner
apps.summary: Coloured banner rendered through BIOS text services; screenshot checked.

apps.name: B64
apps.summary: Help, Base64 encoding of `ABCD` and decoding of `QUJDRA==` are byte-exact.

apps.name: BSUM
apps.summary: Text, empty-file and 20 KiB binary checksums match an independent oracle; usage and missing-file errors verified.

apps.name: SemWare Editor Professional
apps.summary: An input file opens and renders, but typed input does not reach the editor; editing, save and reopen are unverified.

apps.name: SemWare GREP
apps.summary: Finds exactly the two `apple` lines in the fixture.

apps.name: SemWare TSORT
apps.summary: Sorts four input lines into the expected order.

apps.name: SAL compiler SC
apps.summary: Compiles a minimal macro to an 87-byte MAC with the expected signature and message.

apps.name: VisiCalc
apps.summary: No usable worksheet or shell return during the retest; the blank screen remains.

apps.name: Ability Plus 3.0
apps.summary: Main program stops on x87 `FNINIT`; the installer needs a 32-bit operand.

apps.name: PEDIT
apps.summary: Both variants stop on the operand-size prefix `66h`; no editable document.

apps.name: uHex
apps.summary: Help and the 34-byte read-only view work, with display defects; editing, save and reopen are unverified.

apps.name: Directory Maven
apps.summary: The scan path stops on `66h`; help stops at `IN AL,DX`.

apps.name: File Maven
apps.summary: Installer, main executable and launcher pass the clock wait, then fail on `IN AL,DX`; no usable manager.

apps.name: Search
apps.summary: Finds both root and nested matches once; totals and the missing-file result are correct.

apps.name: utf8tocp
apps.summary: Exact UTF-8 ↔ CP437 and UTF-8 ↔ CP775 conversions, including Lithuanian letters and CRLF.

apps.name: Bywater BASIC
apps.summary: LE protected-mode executable rejected; the supplied arithmetic program was not executed.

apps.name: Microsoft Windows 1.01
apps.summary: Setup completes and writes `WIN.COM`/`WIN100.BIN`; startup prints `Incorrect DOS version` and faults; desktop unavailable.

apps.name: Directory Freedom
apps.summary: Directory listing, version 4.61B and the F1-F10 menu render; no file operation was exercised.

apps.name: Costa GUI
apps.summary: Launcher reports `DESKTOP.EXE not found.`; direct `DESKTOP.EXE` stops on `IN AL,21h`.

apps.name: AUMenu
apps.summary: The linked ZIP is the Unix edition: a $79 registration splash appears instead of the DOS menu.

apps.name: VIEW
apps.summary: Opens the 23-page `VIEW.DOC` and a short file; Esc exits. Header overlap and screen remnants remain; paging is untested.

apps.name: DATES
apps.summary: Startup stops on `IN AL,21h` (port `0021h`); no date list or usage text.

apps.name: Cash Register
apps.summary: `POS.EXE` startup stops on `IN AL,21h`; no register screen.

apps.name: Figlet
apps.summary: Correct `ManiOS` standard-font banner; `-I 1` prints `20200`.

apps.name: EDITV
apps.summary: Opens and displays a file and accepts typed text; save and reopen are unverified.

apps.name: MinEd
apps.summary: DJGPP/go32 loader reports `Load error: no DPMI`; no editor screen.

apps.name: As-Easy-As
apps.summary: FPU probe writes `OUT 0F0h`, then runs `FNINIT`/`FSTSW`; no worksheet.

apps.name: VIEWSEEK
apps.summary: Search reports no match for text that is present, then exits with `run-time error R6001`.

apps.name: Info-ZIP UnZip
apps.summary: Lists and CRC-tests `KNOWN.ZIP`; extracts all four members including `SUB/THREE.TXT` with exact hashes; `-p` and `FUNZIP` print the correct text.

apps.name: Info-ZIP Zip
apps.summary: 16-bit builds stop at `0000:0001` (`E5`/`EF`); the 32-bit build reports `no DPMI`; no archive is created.

apps.name: DOSStart
apps.summary: `DANSHELL.EXE` stops on `IN AL,21h` at `1FBB:6B78`; no launcher screen.

apps.name: Spectra
apps.summary: `HITECH.EXE` stops on `IN AL,21h` at `1345:2710`; no GUI.

apps.name: PasswordBox
apps.summary: DJGPP/go32 stub reports `Load error: no DPMI`; no password database.

apps.name: Champ Galagon
apps.summary: Returns to the shell in under 0.6 s with no console output or title screen; no VGA/game frame is reached.

apps.name: Dr Mind Lite
apps.summary: Stops on `OUT 0x3C8` (VGA DAC palette) at `1010:02CA`; no game board.

apps.name: Drobos
apps.summary: Stops on x87 opcode `D8` at `1010:0487`; no game screen.

apps.name: Ford Driving Simulator
apps.summary: Stops on `IN` port `0021h` (PIC) at `1010:10C8`; no simulator screen.

apps.name: Life2
apps.summary: Instructions and EDIT mode render; starting RUN mode stops on `OUT` port `0040h` (PIT channel 0) before a generation.

apps.name: Mahjong!
apps.summary: Stops on operand-size prefix `66h` at `101D:0990`; no screen. The package requires SVGA 1024x768 VESA graphics and a mouse.

apps.name: Mine Mayhem
apps.summary: Stops on operand-size prefix `66h` at `1426:2DC3`; no screen. The executable is a DJGPP/go32 build.

apps.name: Nero 5
apps.summary: Returns to the shell in under 0.6 s with no console output or menu; BGI EGAVGA 640x480 initialization produces no board.

apps.name: ShuffleV
apps.summary: Turbo Vision board renders, then stops on opcode `66h` at `1C36:07FD`; no move is possible.

apps.name: Hanoi
apps.summary: LZEXE startup unpacks, then stops on `IN` port `0006h` at `115B:0603`; no board.

apps.name: TypeFast
apps.summary: Starts and remains running, but the console stays blank; no prompts or game screen appear, so no task is completed.

apps.name: Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
apps.summary: ZIP 2.00 starts the story; room text, commands, inventory, score, save/restore and quit work. The status line still clips its right edge.

apps.name: Adventure (350-point DECUS port)
apps.summary: Starts, accepts a 20-character instructions answer, and completes look, inventory, movement and quit; the quit score is 32/350.

apps.name: Planetfall (Infocom Sampler demo)
apps.summary: The sampler starts and accepts `planet`, but the Planetfall sample text does not render past its first line under ZIP/JZIP; full-game testing was skipped for licensing.
